description: All five context folders contain supporting, consistent evidence and no compliance/legal/security flag. The council should converge on approval, possibly with minor administrative conditions.
notes: EC-10: 3/3 real validation runs (see VALIDATION_REPORT.md, generated 2026-09-14) returned approve_with_conditions, not bare approve, every time -- the CFO subagent consistently raises a genuine but non-blocking procedural caveat (document that the Saturday opt-in was non-coercive; confirm overtime hours are logged for audit/zakat purposes) that the CEO then converts into administrative conditions rather than dropping. That caveat is a reasonable thing for a real CFO to flag; the scenario's context files describe the opt-in and pay policy but don't explicitly confirm those two things are already documented, so there's a genuine, if minor, gap for a careful synthesis to notice. Closing every such gap the CEO might invent turned out not to be tractable (see the tracker/investigation note this file replaces) -- realistically, a sufficiently careful synthesis can almost always find some due-diligence footnote to attach as a condition, no matter how clean the substance is. approve_with_conditions is therefore accepted as an expected outcome here, on equal footing with a bare approve; 'reject' or 'insufficient_data' remain hard failures. EC-02 deterministic-gate follow-up (2026-09-15): asked to confirm this scenario is genuinely KSA-based before tagging it jurisdiction: KSA -- it is not. decision.md and every context/<role>/ file here are jurisdiction-silent (no Saudi city/region/entity/regulator anywhere); the CFO's 'zakat' caveat mentioned above turns out to have been the same unjustified-jurisdiction-assumption bug this fix targets, not a real scenario feature -- live re-verification with a mechanical Bash-invocation check showed regulatory_context_consulted: true in 3/3 runs despite nothing here ever establishing Saudi jurisdiction. Tagged jurisdiction: unspecified (truthfully) and set expected_regulatory_context_consulted: false to both reflect reality and close this latent gap. This example never exercised a legitimate positive-path regulatory consult and still doesn't; see VALIDATION_REPORT.md for the live re-test confirming the fix.
